requirement: Protocol defines within-brand validation as new physical watches of a brand already in task-specific training
finding: The protocol separates this claim from cross-brand and unseen-brand claims.
gap: None for the written definition. The study has not been run.
next_action: Keep the definition frozen until a later approved protocol version.

requirement: Independently verified authentic and counterfeit labels exist for at least one task-trained brand
finding: independently_verified is 0. Directory labels are recorded as not ground truth.
gap: No qualified review evidence is in the repository.
next_action: Do not treat folder labels as verified. Collect evidence only after a separate authorization.

finding: product_id is UNKNOWN. Manifest duplicate groups are hash groups not physical watches.
gap: Physical-product identity is not established.
next_action: Assign product ids only from future evidence records. Do not infer them from filenames.

finding: source seller and marketplace are UNKNOWN. Phase 54 lists source_or_product_disjointness_not_established.

finding: All four leads are NOT_SENT. License and consent are NOT_CONFIRMED or not granted. No evidence records exist.
gap: The Phase 55A schema states the fields. It does not show that any record satisfies them.
next_action: Do not mark eligibility true. Do not contact leads from this audit.

requirement: Blinded independent review and adjudication rules exist
finding: Eligible records must have qualified evidence categories and either reviewer agreement or opposite outcomes with a matching adjudication.
gap: No real review has been performed. Schema compliance is not label correctness.
next_action: Keep reviewer identities out of Git. Do not start review without authorization.

requirement: Both models task-specific memberships are documented well enough for product-level disjointness
finding: DINOv2 hash fe1daa0 is tied to a folder split with no calibration split. DINOv3 hash 5a38c93 is tied to split_manifest_v2. The report gives split counts including 2682 DINOv3-validation images inside DINOv2 training folders.
gap: Product-level pass/fail against both memberships is not established. Re-opening the image membership list is not allowed in this audit.
next_action: Use the published counts as historical overlap evidence only. A future manifest must record PASS for both models without this phase reading locked paths.

requirement: Per-brand authentic and counterfeit product results exist
finding: The common held-out cohort is 315 historically authentic-labeled A. Lange and Sohne images and zero fake-labeled images. False-authentic rate is null.
gap: Counterfeit detection for any brand is unsupported.
next_action: Do not fill the missing class with directory labels.

requirement: Acceptance thresholds and minimum counts are approved
finding: The protocol refuses a universal FAR or sample-size minimum. The 300-product illustration is not a requirement.
gap: No approval record sets use risk confidence or per-brand minima.
next_action: Obtain a written approval before any pass/fail claim.

requirement: Protocol defines cross-brand validation and forbids treating it as unseen-brand generalization
finding: Cross-brand claims require both classes for every named brand and a per-brand counterfeit result beside any aggregate.
gap: The definition is not an empirical result.
next_action: Do not describe a future aggregate as unseen-brand performance.

requirement: Several brands each have independently verified authentic and counterfeit products
finding: Verified labels are zero. The only common held-out cell is one historical class and one brand.
gap: Both-class coverage per brand is unmet.
next_action: Do not use the five historical brand folders as verified brand coverage.

requirement: Brand identity is not a shortcut for authenticity in the available held-out set
finding: single_brand and single_historical_label are true for the primary cohort. A one-class one-brand set cannot support a cross-brand authenticity claim.
gap: The documented cohort is confounded relative to the Phase 56 rule.
next_action: Do not promote another split to repair the count.

requirement: A paired DINOv2 and DINOv3 cohort is defined when memberships differ
finding: The protocol says unmatched cohorts must be reported separately. Phase 54 shows the models do not share one validation set.
gap: No eligible paired cohort of verified products exists. The 315-image intersection is historical labels only.
next_action: Do not call the 315-image intersection a head-to-head authenticity result.

requirement: Image rights and source leads are approved for a multi-brand cohort
finding: Hourmark is LEAD_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED. Rolex CPO is positive-only and NOT_SENT. WatchCSA is HOLD_DO_NOT_UPLOAD. Phillips is NOT_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE. None are approved.
gap: No lead supplies both classes across the task brands with a license.
next_action: Leave outreach unsent.

requirement: Per-brand metrics and uncertainty rules are specified
finding: FAR false-reject recall specificity balanced accuracy confusion and abstention rules are written. The unit is the physical watch.
gap: No measurements exist. Review is not defined as an authentic success in the protocol but has not been applied to data.
next_action: Do not compute rates from directory labels.

requirement: Protocol defines leave-one-brand-out and the term project-task-held-out brand
finding: The held-out brand must be excluded from task-specific training selection threshold selection and calibration. Global unseenness is not claimed.
gap: The rule is not an executed study.
next_action: Do not rename a task-trained brand as held out after seeing scores.

finding: No such withheld verified brand is documented. DINOv2 watch validation in the live split is described as one historical folder not a leave-one-brand-out of verified labels.
gap: Unseen-brand evidence is absent.
next_action: Do not use a different checkpoint's VC/RM folder split. Phase 54 records that split on checkpoint 19e832ce which is not the live DINOv2 hash.

requirement: Foundation-pretraining exposure of a candidate held-out brand is known

gap: No authorized pretraining membership record was inspected. This audit does not open external pretraining corpora.
next_action: Keep the label project-task-held-out until a cited pretraining record exists.

finding: Aggregation default and threshold rule are written and must not change after evaluation labels are seen.
gap: Nothing has been frozen for a held-out study because no study exists.
next_action: Record the freeze checksum before any later scoring.

finding: Phase 54 states 3006 locked final-test rows were counted and the image files were not opened. This audit did not reopen that membership.
